The HWPX training feedback automation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, validating the LangChain graph implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across a 3-minute runtime. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully, confirming the stability of the document automation logic. Future iterations should maintain the current graph structure while monitoring the discrepancy between the perfect verifier score and the slightly lower judge reward.
